task_scope: FactoryBench L1-L3 manufacturing telemetry reasoning from item-provided mappings, time series, options, thresholds, and temporal windows
applicability_conditions: Apply only when the item asks for a supported telemetry prediction, identification, temporal-window selection, or option-by-option Boolean judgment.
Use only signal definitions, timestamps, thresholds, options, and procedures supplied in the current item.
For temporal-window questions, apply only when the requested phase or event can be localized from the supplied time series or explicit event markers.

failure_taxonomy.description: Window starts were selected without validating the requested phase, supplied timestamps, or whether the requested number of timesteps could be formed.
A fixed-length F/T response contained an invalid character, causing a parser failure.
A multi-statement response appears to have missed an option's stated inequality during post-event threshold evaluation.

adapter_text: For each supported item, first identify the requested signal, event, phase, time, options, units, thresholds, and exact answer contract from the item itself. For temporal-window selection, locate the requested phase using only supplied timestamps, event markers, and observable transitions; verify that the proposed start is a supplied timestamp and that the full requested window fits the available ordered samples. Do not invent a phase boundary or choose an arbitrary timestamp when the specification does not support one; outside this temporal-window scope, follow the original task specification. For multi-statement Boolean items, evaluate every option independently against its stated operator and threshold, preserve option order, and encode True as T and False as F. Before responding, validate the output mechanically against the exact item contract: correct number of values or characters, permitted symbols, ordering, numeric form, and no explanatory text. If any supported rule conflicts with the current item specification or falls outside these conditions, follow the original task specification.
fallback_policy: Outside the stated telemetry, temporal-window, Boolean-evaluation, and exact-format conditions, follow the original task specification unchanged.
predicted_regression_risks: Extra validation instructions may add reasoning overhead on straightforward scalar, tensor, ranking, or MCQ items.
Phase-localization guidance may be unhelpful when the item provides an explicit start rule or insufficient temporal evidence.
evidence_limitations: Development evidence contains only six items across two folds.
Temporal-window and threshold mechanisms are observed in limited examples and lack cross-fold replication.
No prior Adapter comparison is available.
